title: gloss/v3
description: v3 (2026-10-17, F29-R1; D-3 v3.44): optional label, the statement's short name (at most 60 characters, plain text, one line), carried by a statement gloss; a node's label is its current statement gloss's. The body of a gloss that carries a label opens with the claim in notation as a display ($$...$$), the convention F20-T16 asks of every statement gloss. Also in v3 (F29-T9, the same day, edited in place before this version was published — D-34 forbids editing a published version only): subject.kind partial, a gloss of one merged partial of the node (its route), whose module is the partial's path under the node, attempts/<stamp>-<pseudonym>-partial.lean, with node set; its current version's first sentence is the route's approach when the partial declared none (F29-R4), and it carries no label. The YAML front matter of nodes/<id>/gloss/<hash>.md or targets/<id>/gloss/<hash>.md (F20-R1; D-3 v3.30): prose saying what one Lean file says — a statement, witness or relation of a node of any status, a merged partial of a node, or a definition module — naming the hash of the exact text described. The body is Markdown, contributor or model text, untrusted downstream. Content-hashed, attributed, unverified, versioned by supersedes, withdrawn by a withdrawal record. Exactly one of author and drafter is set. v2 adds drafted_with (F21-R6; D-3 v3.31, D-23): the model a contributor's agent drafted with. No new version may carry a drafter block (F21-R2). Versioned, never edited (D-34).

node.description: The node, for a statement, witness, relation or partial; null for a definition module.

module.description: The definition module's path under targets/<id>/defs/, for a definition; for a partial, the merged partial's path under the node (attempts/<stamp>-<pseudonym>-partial.lean, F29-T9); null otherwise.

lean_hash.description: SHA-256 of the Lean file's bytes this gloss describes; must equal the file at merge (F20-R3).

supersedes.description: The hash of the version this one replaces — the head of its chain, never one already superseded or withdrawn (D-3 v3.30); null to start a chain.

author.description: The login or pseudonym that wrote this version; null for a draft (then drafter is set).

drafter.description: Set for a draft by the network's drafter (D-3 v3.30), with no human author: its name, the model and version that wrote the text, and the commit of the graph its input was read at.

drafted_with.description: The model and tooling that drafted this version, in the contributor's words (D-23, D-3 v3.31): null or absent for a person's own writing. Contributor text, untrusted downstream.

label.description: The statement's short name (D-3 v3.44): at most 60 characters, no newline, plain text (no $). Contributor text, untrusted downstream. Absent or null on a gloss of a witness, relation, partial or definition module, and on one that names none.
